title: 9-month-old baby wiggles a cat toy and engages with a cat
description:
Taylor shared this clip of her baby boy already locked in as best friends with the family kitty.

The moment felt soft, wholesome, and straight out of a feel-good scroll break.

''My 9-month-old baby boy was watching his daddy play with the cat and decided he wanted to try too,'' Taylor told WooGlobe.

A small hand wiggled the cat toy with serious focus while the kitty followed every move like a loyal teammate.
